mentions.name: DynoWizard
mentions.description: A tool for designing single-table DynamoDB schemas: users define entities and access patterns, get suggested key and GSI designs, and generate access-pattern code (TypeScript and Python), infrastructure code (CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform), and documentation to share with stakeholders. Currently an MVP in progress, with a waitlist on the landing page, and plans to add features for understanding and validating designs beyond what a chatbot can provide.
mentions.problem: Designing single-table DynamoDB schemas has been a manual pen-and-paper (or Excel/Confluence) process, though the method based on The DynamoDB Book can be automated to an extent.
mentions.audience: For developers who design single-table DynamoDB schemas and currently draft them manually with pen and paper or spreadsheets.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building DynoWizard [1] - tool for designing single table DynamoDB tables.
